version: Build guide v4 · CAD v3.4g · 14 Oct 2026
how_to_read: steps[i].ledger lists every occupied hole / pin / pad / screw terminal AFTER step i: where, what is in it, its wire colour, where the other end goes, and the step it was added. steps[i].nets lists what is electrically joined (breadboard strips, wires and board internals) and the supply on it. Breadboard holes are row number + letter (21F); rails are L-/L+/R+/R- @ the row they sit beside. To debug: find the last step the builder ticked, compare its ledger with what is really on the bench, then check the Expect lines.
